metadata.continuousEnvelope: Centered 64 ms stereo-power RMS, 20 ms hop, 100 ms five-frame smoothing inherited unchanged from V1.3A.
metadata.method: V1.3A measured absolute envelope at 20 ms multiplied only by existing bounded V1.3C salience/local/track context factors. Impulse and pulse drive use absolute cue amplitude with the same factors.
